title: Atlas Freight: vague follow-up call
transcript:
Agent: Atlas Freight support, this is Leo. How can I help?
Customer: It is still not working. I do not know, the thing you sent me. Just fix it.
Agent: I want to make sure I understand. Are you calling about a shipment, an invoice, or the tracking page?
Customer: The thing. The one from yesterday. It is not doing what it is supposed to do.
Agent: Can you give me a shipment number or the account name?
Customer: I do not have it in front of me. I am in the truck. It is the usual problem.
Agent: I do not want to guess and send you the wrong information. Can I call you back when you have the shipment number?
Customer: I guess. This is frustrating. Nothing works.
Agent: I understand. I am going to escalate this to a human agent who can pull up your recent shipments and call you back. What is the best number?
Customer: The one on the account. I need to go.
Agent: I will have someone call you within the hour. Thank you for calling Atlas Freight.
